outcome: recalled experience of pregnancy and motherhood
cohort: The study included 33 mothers with Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD) without intellectual disabilities and 32 neurotypical mothers who had experienced pregnancy and motherhood.
finding: Mothers with ASD recalled higher sensory sensitivity during pregnancy and post-partum compared to neurotypical mothers, though it decreased during peri-partum, and higher autistic traits correlated with increased post-partum depressive symptoms.
